title: Latent daily review · Oct 9
tldr: No new fixes from me today. The one real problem in the inbox isn't a code bug: tridha (15) says the age check deleted her account and her 3-week streak. The age code only deletes under-13 answers, so most likely the birthday wheel landed on the wrong year. The account is hard-deleted and I can't bring it back.

You and Malcolm merged 17 PRs since yesterday's dig (#446 to #462), including 1.0.5 (37) for TestFlight, the iOS 26 launch takeover, Pomodoro Keep going, camera-off pauses and the Past feed. Malcolm's #463 (review notes on #462) is open.

8 more testers chose “Stay as a Beta Tester”: 4 left an email (shlokp, charanistired, philan_jin, ankithrao30) and 4 left only a phone number (sydney, junue, chloe, amina). You've answered Radhya, mosimon, Simone, Ali and Jayden, and Jayden wrote back to say thanks.

Sentry: 6 new one-person freezes (APPLE-IOS-65 to 6B). No new in-app feedback, the survey is unchanged (39/25/2 of 66), PostHog group_action_failed is still high (166 on Oct 8, 33 people). Discord wasn't checked today. No PRs, so no Linear issue today.

replyDrafts.subject: Re: TestFlight beta feedback for Latent
replyDrafts.theirMessage:
Heyy
I don’t know my when i entered my age on latent (15 year old) it deleted my acc saying its for 13 and above. I had a 3 week long streak as well. Please help me, i don’t want to lose everything please

I am a high schooler and this really means a lot to me. Please i have trust in you that you’ll brung my account back. Please.
replyDrafts.body:
Hey Tridha, I'm so sorry this happened, that's a really rough way to lose a 3 week streak 😭 The age check only removes accounts when the birthday comes out under 13, so the wheel probably landed on the wrong year. [CHECK: whether you can or want to restore her account or streak; it is hard-deleted in Supabase, so only promise what you can do] You're welcome to sign up again with your real birthday, and I'm here if anything else goes wrong!

Eddie
replyDrafts.note: The account was deleted, not paused (AgeCheck.swift calls deleteAccount for under 13), so don't promise to bring the streak back unless you can.
